$2,500 | 3664 West 2nd Ave, Vancouver | 2BD/1BA Garden-Level Suite | Kitsilano
Property Overview
Welcome to this private, self-contained 2-bedroom legal suite in a charming character home built in 2000, ideally located in the heart of Kitsilano. This bright garden-level home offers a private entrance, a personal patio, and a peaceful residential setting just minutes from Jericho Beach and UBC.
With a functional layout, private laundry, and excellent access to parks, beaches, transit, and shopping, this suite is perfect for professionals, students, or couples seeking comfortable West Side living.

2 Bedrooms | 1 Bathroom
